#Data
```{r load in data}

bites<-read.csv("CC_bite_data_revision.csv", header=TRUE)
names(bites)
class(bites$Catalogue.ID)
bites$Catalogue.ID <- as.factor(bites$Catalogue.ID)
bites$Social.cluster <- as.factor(bites$Social.cluster)
str(bites)
```

#data exploration
```{r lunar data}

### data explroations ####
# get correct date format

bites <- bites %>%
  mutate(Full.Date = as.Date(Full.Date, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),  # Convert date
    Bite.Confirmed.Logic = case_when(
      Bite.Confirmed == "Yes" ~ TRUE,    # Convert "Yes" to TRUE
      Bite.Confirmed == "No" ~ FALSE,   # Convert "No" to FALSE
      TRUE ~ NA),                         # Retain NA for other or missing values
    Bite.Confirmed.Binary = case_when(
      Bite.Confirmed == "Yes" ~ 1,      # Convert "Yes" to 1
      Bite.Confirmed == "No" ~ 0,       # Convert "No" to 0
      TRUE ~ NA))                         # Retain NA for other or missing values

summary_stats <- bites %>%
  summarise(total_whales = n_distinct(Catalogue.ID),
    total_encounters = n_distinct(Group.code),
    total_sightings = n(),
    avg_healing_bites = mean(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_scarred_bites = mean(Total.Scarred.bites, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_with_fresh_bites = mean(Fresh.bite, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
print(summary_stats)

fresh_bite_summary <- bites %>%
  summarise(
    total_fresh_bites = sum(Fresh.bite, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_fresh_bites = mean(Fresh.bite, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
fresh_bite_summary

bite_totals <- bites %>%
  summarise(
    avg_healing_bites = mean(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_avg_healing_bites = sd(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    avg_scarred_bites = mean(Total.Scarred.bites, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_avg_healing_bites = sd(Total.Scarred.bites, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    max_healing_bites = max(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_scarred_bites = max(Total.Scarred.bites, na.rm = TRUE))
print(bite_totals)

fresh_bite_ids <- bites %>%
  filter(Fresh.bite == 1) %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(total_fresh_bites = sum(Fresh.bite, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

total_unique_ids_with_fresh_bites <- nrow(fresh_bite_ids)
print(total_unique_ids_with_fresh_bites)

fresh_bite_distribution <- fresh_bite_ids %>%
  count(total_fresh_bites)

# fresh bite per individual
unique_fresh_bites <- bites %>%
  filter(Total.fresh.bites > 0) %>%  # Include only rows with Total.fresh.bites > 0
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(max_fresh_bites = max(Total.fresh.bites, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # Get max fresh bites per ID
  mutate(category = case_when(
      max_fresh_bites == 1 ~ "single",
      max_fresh_bites == 2 ~ "double",
      max_fresh_bites == 3 ~ "triple",
      TRUE ~ "other"))

fresh_bite_summary <- unique_fresh_bites %>%
  count(category) %>%
  rename(count_of_individuals = n)
fresh_bite_summary

#healing bites per individual
unique_heal_bites <- bites %>%
  filter(Total.healing.bites > 0) %>%  # Include only rows with Total.fresh.bites > 0
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(max_heal_bites = max(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # Get max fresh bites per ID
  mutate(category = case_when(
      max_heal_bites == 1 ~ "single",
      max_heal_bites == 2 ~ "double",
      max_heal_bites == 3 ~ "triple",
      max_heal_bites == 4 ~ "quad",
      max_heal_bites == 5 ~ "cinq",
      max_heal_bites == 6 ~ "six",
      TRUE ~ "other"))

heal_bite_summary1 <- unique_heal_bites %>%
  count(category) %>%
  rename(count_of_individuals = n)
heal_bite_summary1

heal_bite_summary2 <- bites %>%
  filter(Total.healing.bites > 0) %>%  # Include only rows with healing bites
  summarise(total_healing_bites = sum(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE), 
    unique_individuals = n_distinct(Catalogue.ID),               
    total_identification = n(),                                       
    unique_encounters = n_distinct(Group.code))
heal_bite_summary2

#scarred bites per individual
unique_scar_bites <- bites %>%

  mutate(category = case_when(
      max_scar_bites == 1 ~ "one",

scar_bite_summary1 <- unique_scar_bites %>%

scar_bite_summary1

scar_bite_summary <- bites %>%

  summarise(Total.Scarred.bites = sum(Total.Scarred.bites, na.rm = TRUE),

scar_bite_summary

# Time trends for fresh bites
fresh_bite_trends <- bites %>%
  group_by(Full.Date) %>%
  summarise(
    fresh_bite_count = sum(Fresh.bite, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_healing_bites = mean(Total.healing.bites, na.rm = TRUE))
fresh_bite_trends

fresh_bites <- bites %>%
  filter(Fresh.bite == 1)

first_fresh_bites <- fresh_bites %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(first_fresh_date = min(Full.Date, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
first_fresh_bites

subsequent_resightings <- bites %>%
  inner_join(first_fresh_bites, by = "Catalogue.ID") %>%
  filter(Full.Date >= first_fresh_date)
subsequent_resightings

subsequent_resightings <- subsequent_resightings %>%
  mutate(sighting_type = ifelse(Full.Date == first_fresh_date, "First Fresh Bite", "Resighting"))
subsequent_resightings

subsequent_resightings2 <- subsequent_resightings %>%
  filter(Bite.Confirmed == 1 | Fresh.bite == 1 | Total.healing.bites > 0 | Total.Scarred.bites > 0)

subsequent_resightings2 <- subsequent_resightings2 %>%
  mutate(sighting_type = ifelse(Full.Date == first_fresh_date, "First Fresh Bite", "Resighting"))

# Compare with the first sighting's Location
subsequent_resightings2 <- subsequent_resightings2 %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  mutate(same_location = Location == first(Location))  

# Compare with the first sighting's side
subsequent_resightings2 <- subsequent_resightings2 %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    same_side = Sides.of.body.seen == first(Sides.of.body.seen))  

bite_summary <- subsequent_resightings2 %>%
  group_by(sighting_type) %>%
  summarise(total_sightings = n(),
    confirmed_bites = sum(Bite.Confirmed.Logic, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_location_count = sum(same_location, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_side_count = sum(same_side, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_same_location = (same_location_count / total_sightings) * 100,
    percent_same_side = (same_side_count / total_sightings) * 100)
bite_summary

resighting_summary <- subsequent_resightings %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(total_resightings = n() - 1)
resighting_summary

resighting_table <- resighting_summary %>%
  summarise(min_frequency = min(total_resightings, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_frequency = max(total_resightings, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_frequency = mean(total_resightings, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_frequency = sd(total_resightings, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    total_individuals = n_distinct(Catalogue.ID),
    resighted_individuals = sum(total_resightings > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_resighted = (resighted_individuals / total_individuals) * 100)
resighting_table

ggplot(subsequent_resightings, aes(x = Full.Date, y = Catalogue.ID)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sighting_type), size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Timeline of Fresh Bites and Resightings",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Catalogue ID",
       color = "Sighting Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

### resighting analysis
# Ensure we only consider resightings
resightings_analysis <- subsequent_resightings %>%
  filter(sighting_type == "Resighting")

# Compare sides of the body between first fresh bite and resightings
same_side_analysis <- resightings_analysis %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    same_side_seen = sum(Sides.of.body.seen == first(Sides.of.body.seen), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_resightings = n(),
    percent_same_side = (same_side_seen / total_resightings) * 100)
print(same_side_analysis)

# Compare bite locations between first fresh bite and resightings
same_location_analysis <- resightings_analysis %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    same_location_seen = sum(Location == first(Location), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_resightings = n(),
    percent_same_location = (same_location_seen / total_resightings) * 100)
print(same_location_analysis)

combined_analysis <- resightings_analysis %>%
  group_by(Catalogue.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    same_side_seen = sum(Sides.of.body.seen == first(Sides.of.body.seen), na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_same_side = (same_side_seen / n()) * 100,
    same_location_seen = sum(Location == first(Location), na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_same_location = (same_location_seen / n()) * 100,
    total_resightings = n())
print(combined_analysis, n=106)

location_table <- combined_analysis %>%
  summarise(min_same_location = min(same_location_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_same_location = max(same_location_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_same_location = mean(same_location_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_same_location = sd(same_location_seen, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(same_location_seen))),
    min_percent_same_location = min(percent_same_location, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_percent_same_location = max(percent_same_location, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_percent_same_location = mean(percent_same_location, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_percent_same_location = sd(percent_same_location, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(percent_same_location))))
location_table

side_table <- combined_analysis %>%
  summarise(min_same_side = min(same_side_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_same_side = max(same_side_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_same_side = mean(same_side_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_same_side = sd(same_side_seen, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(same_location_seen))),
    min_percent_same_side = min(percent_same_side, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_percent_same_side = max(percent_same_side, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_percent_same_side = mean(percent_same_side, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_percent_side = sd(percent_same_side, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(percent_same_side))))
side_table

### lunar data ####
names(bites)
str(bites)
#lunar phases categorical
lunar.phase(as.Date(bites$Full.Date), shift =-10, name= 8)
bites$lunar.phase <- lunar.phase(as.Date(bites$Full.Date), shift =-10, name= 8)

# need to combine the 8 phases with similar light levels as per (Owen 2019)
# eg waxing & waning gibbous - gibbous, waxing & waning crescent - crescent 

levels(bites$lunar.phase)
bites$lunar.phase <- recode_factor(bites$lunar.phase, "Waxing crescent" = "Crescent",
                                   "Waning crescent" = "Crescent",
                                   "Waxing gibbous" = "Gibbous",
                                   "Waning gibbous" = "Gibbous",
                                   "First quarter" = "Quarter",
                                   "Last quarter" = "Quarter")

#lunar illumination
lunar.illumination(as.Date(bites$Full.Date), shift =-10)
bites$lunar.illumin <- lunar.illumination(as.Date(bites$Full.Date), shift =-10)

# how many unique sightings
bites %>% summarise(count = n_distinct(Catalogue.ID))    

#sll data sightings by season 
sight_agg <- bites %>%  ## Create a new data frame
  group_by(Season) %>%  ## group this data by the "Season" variable
  summarise_at(vars(Fresh.bite), list(Fresh.bite_total = ~sum(., na.rm=TRUE)))
sight_agg

## little thing to see also how many sightings per season as well

  group_by(Season) %>% 
  summarise(n_catalogue_id = length(unique(Catalogue.ID)),

            total_bites = sum(Fresh.bite))
```

#predict bite location
```{r chisq for expected bites}
str(bites)
bites$Location <- as.factor(bites$Location)
# Calculate expected bites based on area seen
bites_proportions <- fresh.bites |> 
  select(Location, Sides.of.body.seen) |> 
  filter(Location != "none") |> 
  group_by(Location, Sides.of.body.seen) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) |> 
  arrange(Sides.of.body.seen) |> 
  group_by(Sides.of.body.seen ) |> 
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n),
         total = sum(n)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(exp_total = ifelse(Sides.of.body.seen == "Both", total, total * 2)) |> 
  # Calculate expected based on area size alone
  mutate(area = c(c(0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2) * 2,
         c(0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2), c(0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2))) |> 
  mutate(exp_n = round(area * exp_total)) |> 
  group_by(Location) |> 
  summarise(n = sum(n),
            exp_n = sum(exp_n))
bites_proportions
bites_percentages <- bites_proportions |> 
  mutate(percent_bites = (n / sum(n)) * 100)

bites_percentages
# Run chi-square test
chisq.test(bites_proportions |> select(-Location))
```

```{r create and fit gamm}
#install.packages("AICcmodavg")
library(AICcmodavg)

#define list of models
models <- list(Gmm1$mer, Gmm1a$mer, Gmm1b$mer, Gmm1c$mer, Gmm1d$mer, Gmm1e$mer, Gmm1f$mer)

#specify model names
mod.names <- c("temp", "day", "lunar", "day.temp", "day.lunar", "temp.lunar", "day.lunar.temp")

#calculate AIC of each model
aictab(cand.set = models, modnames = mod.names)
BIC(Gmm1$mer, Gmm1a$mer, Gmm1b$mer, Gmm1c$mer, Gmm1d$mer, Gmm1e$mer, Gmm1f$mer)
summary(Gmm1f$gam)

# compare the best fitting model gamm against the gam
full_model <-   gamm4(fresh ~ s(day) + s(lunar_illum) + temp,
    random = ~ (1 | cluster),
    offset(body),
    family = binomial(link = "cloglog"),
    data = bites)

reduced_mdel <- gam(fresh ~ s(day) + s(lunar_illum) + temp,
    offset(body),
    family = binomial(link = "cloglog"),
    data = bites)

# Extract log-likelihoods
logLik_full <- logLik(full_model$mer)
logLik_reduced <- logLik(reduced_mdel)

# Perform likelihood ratio test
lr_stat <- -2 * (logLik_reduced - logLik_full)
p_value <- pchisq(lr_stat, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Summary of the full model to check variance component
summary_full_model <- summary(full_model$mer)

# Extract variance component for the random effect
variance_random_effect <- summary_full_model$varcor$cluster[1,1]
std_dev_random_effect <- sqrt(variance_random_effect)
residual_variance <- pi^2 / 3

# Calculate ICC
icc <- variance_random_effect / (variance_random_effect + residual_variance)
icc
# Confidence intervals for the variance component
conf_intervals <- confint(full_model$mer)
str(conf_intervals)
# Extract the confidence intervals for the variance component of the random effect
# Identify the row name corresponding to the random effect (assuming ".sig01" is the one)
confint_random_effect <- conf_intervals[".sig01", ]

# random effect variance


# Print results
cat("Variance component for random effect (cluster):", variance_random_effect, "\n")
cat("Standard deviation for random effect (cluster):", std_dev_random_effect, "\n")
cat("Likelihood Ratio Test Statistic:", lr_stat, "\n")
cat("p-value:", p_value, "\n")
cat("95% Confidence Interval for variance component:", confint_random_effect, "\n")
cat("AIC for full model:", AIC(full_model$mer), "\n")
cat("AIC for reduced model:", AIC(reduced_mdel), "\n")

##### ## looking for peaks in data ######
# preidctions
# Generate new data for prediction
newdata <- data.frame(
  temp = mean(temp),  # Keep temp constant, you may choose another value or a sequence
  day = seq(min(day), max(day), length.out = 365),  # Julian days for a year
  cluster = unique(cluster)[1],  # Choose one cluster for prediction
  body = mean(body),  # Average body offset
  lunar_illum = seq(min(lunar_illum), max(lunar_illum), length.out = 365)  # Sequence of lunar illumination
)

# Predict with standard errors
predictions.new <- predict(Gmm1f$gam, newdata, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)

# Calculate 95% confidence intervals
predictions.new$upper <- predictions.new$fit + 1.96 * predictions.new$se.fit
predictions.new$lower <- predictions.new$fit - 1.96 * predictions.new$se.fit

# Combine predictions with newdata
prediction_data <- data.frame(
  day = newdata$day,
  fit = predictions.new$fit,
  upper = predictions.new$upper,
  lower = predictions.new$lower
)

# Function to identify peaks
find_peaks <- function(x) {
  peaks <- which(diff(sign(diff(x))) == -2) + 1
  return(peaks)
}

# Identify peaks in predictions
peaks <- find_peaks(prediction_data$fit)
# Extract peak details
peak_details <- prediction_data[peaks, ]

# Calculate SE from upper and lower bounds
peak_details$se_upper <- (peak_details$upper - peak_details$fit) / 1.96
peak_details$se_lower <- (peak_details$fit - peak_details$lower) / 1.96

# Check if the SE values are similar
peak_details$se <- apply(peak_details[, c("se_upper", "se_lower")], 1, mean)

# Display peak details
peak_details

# Plot with peaks highlighted
ggplot(prediction_data, aes(x = day, y = fit)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = peak_details, aes(x = day, y = fit), color = "red", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Julian day of the year", y = "Predicted Presence/Absence of fresh bites", title = "GAMM Predictions with 95% CI") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#CV
```{r Cross-validation}
# Set a cutoff value for classification
cutoff <- 0.5
# Split data
fold_index <- createFolds(fresh)

# Loop through folds
mse_total <- foreach(i = 1:length(fold_index),.combine = "c") %do%
  {
    print(i)
    
    # Get testing and training row indices
    testing_rows <- fold_index[[i]]
    training_rows <- (1:length(fresh))[-testing_rows]
    
    # Extract training data
    fresh_train <- fresh[training_rows]
    temp_train <- temp[training_rows]
    cluster_train <- cluster[training_rows]
    day_train <- day[training_rows]
    body_train <- bites$body[training_rows]
    lunar_illum_train <- lunar_illum[training_rows]
    
    # Build into data frame
    gamm_df_train <-
      data.frame(
        fresh = fresh_train,
        temp = temp_train,
        cluster = cluster_train,
        day = day_train,
        body = body_train,
        lunar_illum = lunar_illum_train
      )
    
    # Fit model
    gam_train <-
      gamm4(
        fresh ~ temp + s(day) + s(lunar_illum),
        random = ~ (1 | cluster),
        weights = body,
        family = binomial(link = "cloglog"),
        data = gamm_df_train
      ) 
    
    # Extract testing data
    fresh_test <- fresh[testing_rows]
    temp_test <- temp[testing_rows]
    cluster_test <- cluster[testing_rows]
    day_test <- day[testing_rows]
    body_test <- bites$body[testing_rows]
    lunar_illum_test <- lunar_illum[testing_rows]
    
    # Build into data frame
    gamm_df_test <-
      data.frame(
        fresh = fresh_test,
        temp = temp_test,
        cluster = cluster_test,
        day = day_test,
        body = body_test,
        lunar_illum = lunar_illum_test
      )
    
    # Get predictions
    probs <- predict(gam_train$gam, gamm_df_test, type = "response") > cutoff
    mse(gamm_df_test$fresh, probs)
  }

# Calculate RMSE and SD
sqrt(sum(mse_total))
sd(mse_total)
```
